housing.summary: The August 2026 crowd-sourced snapshot reports EUR 755.56 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre; Immobiliare.it provides a Modena rental search. A city-wide deposit norm was not established.

banking.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo states that opening its online current account requires a valid identity document and an Italian tax code; its official page also verifies the bank named here.
required_docs: Valid identity document: identity card, driving licence, or passport
Italian tax code (codice fiscale) or valid health card

schools.summary: International School of Modena states that it offers the IB Primary Years, Middle Years, and Diploma Programmes in English-based international schooling.

legal_admin.summary: A newcomer establishing residence in Modena submits a residence declaration to the Comune; the official guidance requires valid identity documents and proof of the right to occupy the accommodation, with additional documents depending on citizenship.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit the Modena residence declaration online and upload the required identity, accommodation, and citizenship-specific documents.

tax_finance.summary: The Italian tax identification number is the codice fiscale. Non-EU citizens normally receive it through the immigration desk or Questura during qualifying immigration procedures; EU citizens and other applicants can apply through the Revenue Agency, and a first application by a foreign citizen requires an in-person appointment.

transport.summary: SETA operates the Modena urban service and lists an ordinary monthly Urbano Modena pass at EUR 32. Driving-licence rules come from the Italian transport ministry, and healthcare registration comes from AUSL Modena.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences are equivalent to Italian licences and generally remain usable until expiry; non-EU/EEA licence holders may drive for up to one year after acquiring Italian residence, then conversion is possible only where a reciprocity agreement applies, otherwise an Italian licence must be obtained. Source: https://www.mit.gov.it/conversione-patente-estera
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible newcomers apply to AUSL Modena using the form for their citizenship category; eligible non-EU applicants can submit the form in person or by email with identity document, codice fiscale, and residence-permit evidence, plus condition-specific documents. Source: https://www.ausl.mo.it/modulistica-aziendale/iscrizione-ssn-stranieri-scelta-medico-pediatra/
